## The task
What MLatom task should this skill cover? (One task, e.g. "run an AIQM3 reactive MD".)

## Why it's useful
Who would use it, and for what?

## Are you offering to write it?
- [ ] Yes, I can open a PR (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] No, I'm suggesting it for someone else to pick up

## Notes
Reference workflow, paper, or docs if any.
